title: Membership
html:
Becoming a member in Dungeon Runners has many advantages:

  • Members gain experience 15% faster than free players.
  • Members now find 15% more gold than free players.
  • Free players pay 50% more King's Coin when buying items.
  • You have a bank where you can store items with up to 5 pages of storage. Three pages are available at level 1, 4 pages at level 50, and all 5 pages are available at level 100.
  • You can wear all Yellow, Purple and Mythic items! (Non-members can only access 25% of Purple and 5% of Mythic)
  • When a world is Full you have a higher priority to get in than non-members.
  • Access to PvE World 2, a Membership Required server.
  • Stackable Potions - Major potions can be stacked 10 to a stack, and Waypoint Scrolls now stack 5 high.
  • You can use voice chat. When a group is formed voice chat is enabled. Non-members can hear members speak.
